domain: Intersection of kernel-contract engineering and anagama thermal-state: places where the instrumentation that witnesses irreversible state transitions (events, cursors, gates, audit) mis-records, under-records, or falsely certifies the transitions it exists to witness
axioms: Every consumer-visible behavior must be explicit, versioned contract, never an accident of the current implementation (parent A)
Event delivery semantics (ordering, at-least-once, replay, cursor TTL) are contract and must be documented (parent A)
Committed transitions are one-way; irreversibility must be by design, never by accident (parent B)
Every state mutation must leave an entry in the firing record — an unlogged stoke makes replay certify a curve that never happened (parent B)

CONTRADICTION (investigated, not resolved): contract engineering treats instrumentation as a description of state; firing practice treats instrumentation as PART of the irreversible process — a wrong witness doesn't just misreport the firing, it corrupts every later decision that trusts the record
A witness written after and outside the irreversible act is optional plumbing, and optional plumbing is what gets dropped under transactional pressure
A witness that falsely declares the record corrupt is worse than no witness — it burns the record's credibility for every later decision
primitives: witness obligation (per-transition, in-tx, with evidence payload)
completeness certificate (events_expected vs events_found, sparsity in exit code)
command-shaped event (re-delivery commits irreversible effects) vs informational event
chain fork vs tamper (verifier must distinguish)
classified tombstone (witness write precedes/replaces the destructive DELETE)
cursor as firing machinery (a zeroed cursor re-fires logged stokes)
failure_mode: Settled premises (f-039 nil-recorder, f-045 replay holes, f-135 cursor-0, V4 audit-dead) are owned as premises — re-litigating them is out of charter
Contingent-design findings (f-188/f-189) bite only when the audit wiring lands; harm is real but conditional on the remediation being executed naively
Cannot weigh the performance cost of making every witness write transactional
fd-canonization-safety owns duplicate-merging semantics — witness/instrumentation ground only
